subtext: A team of 20+ experts. Every discipline covered. We design, engineer, and scale digital products end-to-end — no outsourcing, no fluff, no middlemen.

members.name: Tejas Kumar Singh
members.title: Founder & CTO
members.quote: Ship fast, scale smarter — never compromise the craft.
members.bio: Tejas leads technology and product strategy at Webvance. With a focus on scalable architecture and clean engineering, he ensures every product we build is reliable, high-performance, and ready to grow.

members.name: Unnati Rajpoot
members.title: Head of Design & UX
members.quote: Great design isn't seen — it's felt in every interaction.
members.bio: Unnati leads design and user experience across all products. Her background at Infosys and deep understanding of user behavior help transform complex ideas into intuitive digital experiences.

members.name: Piyush Gupta
members.title: Head of Leads & SEO
members.quote: If the right people can't find you, everything else is noise.
members.bio: Piyush drives lead generation and search visibility. Combining technical expertise with growth strategy, he ensures our clients' platforms attract the right audience and convert consistently.

members.name: Atharv Singh
members.title: Head of Product & Client Success
members.quote: Value delivered is the only metric that ever truly matters.
members.bio: Atharv manages product delivery and client success. His product management background ensures every project stays aligned with business goals while delivering measurable value.
